personality: 3 Editorial Mobile (Editorial structure fused with warm, traditional cultural earthy/burgundy tones)
personality_one_liner: A culturally rich, editorial-led reference experience that feels like a beautifully bound traditional manuscript.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical rhythms. Let typography and whitespace breathe to emphasize the cultural proverbs.

do's: Skip glass to maintain the matte, traditional paper/manuscript feel
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism anywhere in this editorial setup

screens.name: Ana Sayfa (Home)
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard combining daily inspiration and quick access to gamified features.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in brandPrimary color.
states.error: Error reading local database, with a 'Tekrar Dene' button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Makallakap' logo (serif) and settings cog. A large 'Günün Atasözü' hero card using the burgundy/gold abstract texture as background, text overlaid with a vertical dark scrim (transparent -> 80% surfaceInverse at bottom) for contrast, the proverb in large Cormorant Garamond. Below it, quick actions for 'Rastgele Atasözü', 'Son Görüntülenenler' horizontal scroll, and a banner for 'Quiz'e Başla' showcasing the current daily streak.

screens.name: Atasözleri (Browse)
screens.purpose: Efficiently navigate and search the ~3500 proverbs.

states.loading: Skeleton list rows mimicking text widths.
states.empty: Illustration of an open vintage book with text 'Sonuç bulunamadı' and clear search button.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top with filter icon. Alphabetical quick-jump rail (A-Z) fixed on the right edge. List items display the proverb (serif) and a 1-line snippet of meaning (sans). Separated by subtle dividers (1px border). Scroll performance prioritized.

screens.name: Kategoriler
screens.purpose: Browse proverbs by themes or contexts.
screens.layout: A 2-column grid. Each category card has a brandTertiary tinted background with an earthy Feather icon, a title in serif, and a count badge. Cards fill the row utilizing space-between.

screens.name: Atasözü Detay (Detail)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into the meaning, story, and usage of a specific proverb.
screens.layout: Editorial full-width layout. Huge serif proverb text at the top, a subtle gold divider, then structured sections: 'Anlamı', 'Açıklaması', 'Hikâyesi', 'Kullanım Örneği'. Bottom bar fixed (sticky outside scroll area) containing secondary actions: 'Sesli Oku (TTS)', 'Paylaş', and 'Favoriye Ekle' (heart icon turning brandPrimary when active).

screens.name: Quiz
screens.layout: Distraction-free card layout. Top progress bar. The question in large serif text. Options presented as stacked surfaceSecondary cards. Selecting an option briefly highlights it success/error color, popping a subtle haptic, then advances.

screens.name: Favoriler & Ayarlar
screens.purpose: Manage saved items and user preferences.

states.empty: Vintage book illustration with 'Henüz favorilere eklenmiş atasözü yok.'

screens.layout: Favoriler: Simple list view identical to Atasözleri but without the A-Z rail. Ayarlar: Grouped list sections for 'Tema' (Açık/Koyu/Sistem), 'Yazı Boyutu', etc., with right-aligned values or toggles.

hero_background_abstract.alt: Burgundy and gold abstract texture for Günün Atasözü hero card

empty_state_book.alt: Vintage open book representing empty states for favorites or search

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing heavily on typography. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for proverbs and prominent titles to give the traditional, editorial feel. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (sans-serif) for body text, explanations, and UI controls for readability.

Implement a warm color scheme. The Light theme uses creamy parchment colors (surface: #FDFBF7) and the Dark theme uses deep, warm charcoal (surface: #1A1412). Avoid ANY blue, indigo, or purple. Stick entirely to the burgundy/gold/earth tokens provided.

For the 'Günün Atasözü' hero card on the Home screen, overlay the proverb text on the 'hero_background_abstract' image. MUST apply a vertical gradient scrim (Layer 1) from transparent to 80% surfaceInverse at the bottom to guarantee text readability.
Do NOT use glassmorphism/blur anywhere in this app. The editorial personality relies on matte, solid colors (paper-like aesthetics).
Ensure Turkish character support (ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş, ü) is perfect, especially for the A-Z alphabetical scroll rail in the Browse page.
For Quiz interactions, add haptic feedback (success/error) when the user taps an option.
Keep empty states visual by utilizing the provided 'empty_state_book' image with a primary call to action.
